description: This file contains the implementation of the ReturnStatus class, which is a controller in the OpenCart admin module for managing return statuses within the localisation namespace. It includes methods to list, add, edit, delete, and display forms for return statuses, integrating language translation, URL building, permissions checks, and views rendering.

classes.name: ReturnStatus
classes.description: A controller class in the admin module for managing localisation return statuses, providing CRUD operations, listing, and form display functionalities in the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads the localisation/return_status language, sets the page title, builds URL parameters, prepares breadcrumbs, and renders the main listing view with data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the display of the list of return statuses, supports sorting, pagination, and fetches data from the model to populate the view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of return statuses based on sorting, ordering, and pagination parameters, returning the rendered view for the list.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a return status, populating data as necessary for modifications.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new or existing return status, with permission checks, validation, and JSON response with success or error messages.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return statuses, with permission verification and returns a JSON response indicating success or errors.
